primary.title: Nasdaq 100 sinks 5.6% in worst week since Covid, S&P 500 corrects to 3.7% as investors sell off AI, tech stocks
primary.summary: AI investment concerns triggered a broad selloff, pushing the S&P 500 into correction territory and the Nasdaq 100 to its worst week since March 2020. The sharp market pullback reflected worries about slowing data-center construction, tighter AI-project funding and weaker technology earnings growth.
